move.subject: SH-220 – commercial and delivery counterproposal
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your proposal. We will award 6,000 units annually over 24 months to one supplier. Delivery must be no later than 42 days; our preferred lead time is 35 days.
We propose EUR 12.80 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP. Alternatively, we propose EUR 13.00 per unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
Please confirm achievable delivery and your best executable package. If freight or payment is the main constraint, please identify it so that we can structure the award accordingly.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.
Please let me explain.
Thank you for sharing your target volume; please provide the delivery schedules or historical data to confirm this volume so we can fully factor it into our pricing.
We can meet your maximum lead time of 42 days, which allows us to reduce our price to EUR 15.50 per unit under EXW and 45 days payment terms.
A 35-day lead time would require additional shifts, limiting our ability to offer a more competitive price.
Which volume can you commit to?
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.body:

Please factor in the full-volume commitment and the longer lead time and return your best approved package.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
